name: What is the difference between a minor roof damage assessment and a full roof inspection?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a minor roof damage assessment and a full roof inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: A minor roof damage assessment focuses on specific, visible areas of concern or recent damage, like after a storm. A full roof inspection, however, is a more comprehensive evaluation of the entire roof system, including its structure, decking, ventilation, and overall condition, often performed as preventative maintenance or before buying a home. Our assessments can clarify which type of service is most appropriate for your needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: A minor damage assessment targets specific concerns, while a full inspection comprehensively evaluates the entire roof system.
